sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: Then, how does Toastmasters train people?
sentences.zh: 那么，国际演讲会是怎样培训学员的呢？

sentences.en: Toastmasters has an approach of learning by doing.
sentences.zh: 国际演讲会采取在实践中学习的方法。

sentences.en: The Toastmasters International organization provides a manual we refer to as the basic manual, because it gives a guideline for the development of speeches.
sentences.zh: 国际演讲会组织提供一本手册，我们把它称为基础手册，因为它为演讲的准备提供指导。

sentences.en: These speeches cater to different purposes.
sentences.zh: 这些演讲服务于不同的目标。

sentences.en: For example, one objective might be to develop vocal variety; another might be to organize your thoughts or develop your use of humor in speeches.
sentences.zh: 例如，一个目标可能是让声音更富变化，另一个可能是组织思路，或提高在演讲中运用幽默的能力。

sentences.en: Can you also learn other skills, such as parliamentary procedures or being master of ceremonies?
sentences.zh: 学员还能学到其他技能吗，比如会议议事程序，或者担任主持人？

sentences.en: Yes, different assignments within Toastmasters involve not only preparation of speeches and then presenting these before an audience, but also the opportunity of serving as toastmaster of the meeting.
sentences.zh: 是的，国际演讲会安排的不同任务，不仅包括准备演讲并在听众面前发表，还包括担任会议主持人的机会。

w.m: n. 宴会或会议主持人

sentences.en: This assignment helps members practice being an MC for a meeting, that is, a master of ceremonies.
sentences.zh: 这项任务帮助会员练习担任会议的MC，也就是主持人。

sentences.en: Other assignments include serving as an evaluator for another speaker, or serving as grammarian who will monitor use of filler words or phrases, such as “and”, “uh”, “er” or “you know”.
sentences.zh: 其他任务包括为另一位演讲者担任评估员，或者担任语言监督员，留意“and”“uh”“er”“you know”等填充词或短语的使用。

w.m: n. 语言监督员（此演讲会中的角色）

sentences.en: Both of these assignments will allow the member to increase or enhance their listening skills.
sentences.zh: 这两项任务都能让会员增强或提升自己的倾听能力。

sentences.en: I know that there is an eight-week program for young people and also an eight-week speech craft course offered for adults.
sentences.zh: 我知道，你们有一个面向年轻人的八周项目，还有一个面向成年人的八周演讲技巧课程。

sentences.en: What do these involve?
sentences.zh: 这些课程包括什么内容？

sentences.en: They are basically an introduction to Toastmasters in general.
sentences.zh: 它们基本上是对国际演讲会的总体介绍。

sentences.en: A sample, providing the opportunity for an individual to determine whether or not they wish to get involved in Toastmasters by joining a club.
sentences.zh: 它们相当于一种体验，让个人有机会判断，自己是否愿意加入一个分会，参与国际演讲会的活动。

sentences.en: What can an individual gain from being in Toastmasters?
sentences.zh: 个人加入国际演讲会能获得什么呢？

sentences.en: I would say, self-confidence and some tricks of the trade in the development of speeches.
sentences.zh: 我想，是自信，以及一些提升演讲水平的实用诀窍。

sentences.en: But that is only the beginning.
sentences.zh: 但这仅仅是个开始。

sentences.en: As an individual continues to give speeches and improve, he progresses from the point of being fearful to stand before a group of peers to the point where he can address any group of people with a degree of self-confidence.
sentences.zh: 随着一个人不断演讲、不断进步，他会从害怕站到一群同辈面前，逐步成长为能够带着一定自信向任何一群人讲话的人。

w.m: v. 逐步提高；取得进步

sentences.en: Leadership skills are also developed by learning to organize and conduct meetings.
sentences.zh: 通过学习组织和主持会议，领导能力也能得到培养。

sentences.en: OK. Thank you very much, Mrs. Collins, for talking to us in the studio.
sentences.zh: 好的。柯林斯女士，非常感谢您来到演播室接受我们的访谈。

sentences.en: You’re most welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: This is the end of part two of the interview.
sentences.zh: 访谈的第二部分到此结束。
